verdict_text:
YES

The script builds the keep index for each layer correctly: for the fused `query_key_value` weight and bias (axis 0, one segment of 6144, block 768) it drops rows 3840..4607 and keeps 0..3839 then 4608..6143 in order, and for `dense.weight` (axis 1, block 256) it drops columns 1280..1535 and keeps 0..1279 then 1536..2047. It touches only the three head-bearing tensors in all 16 layers, preserves names and float16 dtype via `index_select`, asserts the four required checks before saving, and writes a single file to `out/T2/model.safetensors` with all 244 tensors.
